observed_ui_times_utc.source: parent agent observed public UI timeline

readiness.interpretation: The service intentionally withdraws readiness during every replay/account-cut refresh. The last fixed inventory-change diagnostic is historical; current HTTP 503 does not prove the same error persists.

limitations: Stored receipt and settlement signature presence was read; this collector did not cryptographically verify the browser successor.
The parent independently reports UI recovery at journal revision 21, pending null, receipt b94aa1a7-1ea8-46ae-b35c-764f0e05c52c, charge 0, remaining 1000000 micro-USDC.
No exact pre-dispatch failure reason was retained by current worker diagnostics. Admission/liveness failure is consistent with readiness observations but is not a proven root cause.
This report does not claim a successful OpenAI response, provider metering acceptance, completed I10 or release gates.

methodology.database: Local PostgreSQL SELECT-only queries with default_transaction_read_only=on; only fixed public IDs, state enums, integer totals and signed-presence fields retained. No credential, token, prompt, response text or raw DB rows retained.
methodology.logs: Only parsed provider_dispatch event count and compile-time allowlisted indexer category/numeric cursor retained; raw logs were not exported.

queries.label: session
queries.read_only_sql: SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT state,close_requested,cap_micro::text,charged_nano::text,reserved_nano::text,active_operations FROM sessions WHERE request_id='3019e6e0-0ca7-48a8-844f-fd72bfb9d1fb') t

queries.label: operation
queries.read_only_sql: SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT state,reservation_nano::text,charged_nano::text,observed_cost_nano::text,operator_loss_nano::text,dispatched_at IS NULL AS no_dispatched_timestamp,provider_request_id IS NULL AS no_provider_request_id FROM operations WHERE request_id='3019e6e0-0ca7-48a8-844f-fd72bfb9d1fb' AND operation_id='e4db2880-b71f-4a23-a301-f8d066a8f760') t

queries.label: receipt
queries.read_only_sql: SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,signature IS NOT NULL AS signed,convert_from(canonical_body,'UTF8')::json->>'reason' AS reason,convert_from(canonical_body,'UTF8')::json->>'evidence_kind' AS evidence_kind,convert_from(canonical_body,'UTF8')::json->>'charged_nano_usdc' AS charged_nano_usdc,json_array_length(convert_from(canonical_body,'UTF8')::json->'usage') AS usage_entries FROM receipts WHERE request_id='3019e6e0-0ca7-48a8-844f-fd72bfb9d1fb' AND operation_id='e4db2880-b71f-4a23-a301-f8d066a8f760') t

queries.label: settlement
queries.read_only_sql: SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT charge_micro::text,state_signature IS NOT NULL AS signed FROM settlements WHERE request_id='3019e6e0-0ca7-48a8-844f-fd72bfb9d1fb') t
